title: Platform-Wide Orphaned Code, Dead Tests, Stale Docs & Transient File Hygiene 10/10 Overhaul (Zero-Breakage Safety Protocol, Dry-Run Quarantine & Full Real-DOM Operational Verification)
spec: # DIR-028: Platform-Wide Orphaned Code, Dead Tests, Stale Docs & Transient File Hygiene Overhaul ## 1. Executive Context & Inviolable Safety Mandate While eliminating technical debt, orphaned files, dead test probes, and obsolete documentation is critical for long-term codebase health, **OPERATIONAL INTEGRITY IS NON-NEGOTIABLE**. Removing dead code or docs must NEVER break a running feature, unmount an active route, disrupt canonical CI test suites, or delete living architectural references. This directive mandates a rigorous, 5-phase **Zero-Breakage Operational Safety Protocol** for comprehensive codebase hygiene: 1. **Multi-Root Static & Dynamic Dependency, Test & Doc Census** (prevent false positives). 2. **Mandatory Dry-Run Manifest & Lead Approval Gate** (no deletions without Supervisor sign-off). 3. **Reversible Quarantine Staging** (instant atomic rollback in < 5s). 4. **5-Tier Operational Verification** (ESLint, Build < 4.0s, 651/651 Unit Tests, and 68-Route Playwright Browser Crawl). 5. **Automated Fail-Closed Rollback** (any single error triggers immediate git restoration). ## 2. The 5-Phase Zero-Breakage Operational Safety Protocol ### Phase 1: Multi-Root Dependency, Test & Doc Census (Zero False-Positives) Before proposing any item for excision, `.bridge/evidence/orphan-code-census.mjs` must scan across 9 distinct roots: 1. **Static AST Imports**: `import ... from '...'` and `require('...')`. 2. **Dynamic React Imports**: `React.lazy(() => import('...'))` and dynamic `import()` expressions. 3. **Router Path Declarations**: Route mappings in `main.jsx`, `DashboardMain.jsx`, `EmployerPortal.jsx`, `EnterpriseConsole.jsx`, and `Admin.jsx`. 4. **CSS & Asset References**: `url('...')`, `@import`, and inline `` / SVG icon lookups. 5. **Dynamic Template & String Registries**: Dynamic resume template identifiers (`Cv1`..`Cv51`, `TemplateRenderer`), portfolio themes, and i18n locales. 6. **Backend Public APIs & Webhook Handlers**: Endpoint paths called via `apiJson(path)` or `fetch(path)`. 7. **Orphaned Test Files & Diagnostic Probes**: Catalog one-off diagnostic scripts (`tests/e2e/*probe*.spec.js`, `tests/e2e/*diag*.spec.js`, `tests/e2e/*offender*.spec.js`, `tests/reproduce-*.mjs`) created for temporary bug reproduction that are NOT part of `npm run test:product` or canonical CI suites. 8. **Stale & Superseded Documentation**: Audit `.md` files in `docs/` and project root for obsolete guides referencing deprecated architectures (e.g. legacy Firestore data layer, excised external scrapers, or temporary transition blueprints like `DASHBOARD_UI_UX_REPLACEMENT_BLUEPRINT.md` that are already frozen). 9. **Transient & Residual Debug Artifacts**: Audit transient directories (`crawl-artifacts/`, obsolete screenshot dumps, stale `.tmp`/`.bak` files, residual debug traces) for safe purging. ### Phase 2: Dry-Run Manifest Submission & Lead Gate - Cline must output `.bridge/evidence/ORPHAN_CLEANUP_DRYRUN_MANIFEST.json` cataloging: - Candidate file paths, byte sizes, and category (`ORPHAN_CODE`, `DEAD_TEST_PROBE`, `STALE_DOC`, `TRANSIENT_ARTIFACT`). - Mathematical proof of 0 references across all 9 dependency and system roots. - **HARD STOP**: Cline is strictly prohibited from deleting any file until the Lead Supervisor reviews the manifest via `bridge_lead_review` and grants formal approval. ### Phase 3: Reversible Quarantine Staging - Approved candidate files are moved into a non-compiled quarantine ledger (`.bridge/quarantine/`) or isolated in a single atomic git commit. - If any issue arises in Phase 4, the quarantine is instantly undone via `git restore`. ### Phase 4: 5-Tier Operational Verification Gate Cleanup is considered successful ONLY when ALL 5 tiers pass with 100% perfection: 1. **Static Analysis**: `npx eslint` passes with **0 errors**. 2. **Production Compilation**: `npm run build` succeeds in **< 4.0s** with 0 unresolved imports. 3. **Automated Regression Suite**: Full product suite passes with **100% green (651 / 651 assertions pass)**. 4. **Real-DOM 68-Route Browser Crawl (Playwright)**: Physically crawl all 68 canonical routes in headless Chromium, asserting: - HTTP 200 response on every route. - `console.error` count = **0**. - No unhandled runtime exceptions. - Active landmark containers (`main#main-content`) render real child nodes (zero blank screens). 5. **INV-1 Baseline Verification**: `git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js` = strictly **0 bytes**. ### Phase 5: Automated Fail-Closed Rollback Policy If even a single test fails, a single route returns 404, or an uncaught runtime error is logged, Cline must immediately abort, execute `git restore`, and log the regression to the Bridge ledger.
invariants: INV-1: Frozen Baseline Integrity: git diff e314f715 -- src/cv-templates/ backend/services/aiRuntime.js must remain STRICTLY 0 bytes (57 CV templates + AI runtime frozen).

INV-2: Zero Breaking Deletions (Zero False Positives): Never delete any file, export, route, or asset that is referenced directly, dynamically, or via string keys in any route table, template renderer, or test suite.

INV-3: Mandatory Lead Supervisor Approval Gate: Staff Developer (Cline) must NEVER delete files without first submitting the dry-run manifest and receiving formal Lead approval via bridge_lead_review.
INV-4: Instant Reversibility & Atomic Commit: All removals must be staged in a single reversible commit with automated rollback if any test or route check fails.

INV-5: 100% Test & Route Integrity: npm run test:product (651/651 pass) and full 68-route Playwright browser crawl (0 errors, 0 blank viewports, 0 HTTP>=400) must pass flawlessly before Gatekeeper certification.
INV-6: Performance Budget: Vite production build wall duration must remain strictly < 4.0s.

INV-7: Canonical Test & Living Doc Protection: Never delete or mutate canonical regression test suites (npm run test:product), Playwright certified directive suites (dir006 through dir027), or live architectural runbooks (CUBA_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, PRODUCTION_RUNBOOK.md, IME365_RBAC_MATRIX.md).
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Multi-Root Static & Dynamic Dependency Scanner: Author .bridge/evidence/orphan-code-census.mjs scanning across static imports, dynamic lazy imports, router paths, CSS url references, dynamic template loaders (Cv1..Cv51), backend API routes, test suites, docs, and transient directories, producing .bridge/evidence/ORPHAN_CLEANUP_DRYRUN_MANIFEST.json.
AC-2: Formal Lead Approval Gate: Submit the dry-run manifest to Lead Supervisor and await formal approval before performing any file deletions or modifications.

AC-3: Surgical Staging & Zero-Breaking Excision: Safely excise only approved, verified dead files (orphaned legacy prototypes, unused deprecated styles, superseded Firestore stubs) in a single atomic, reversible change set.

AC-4: Production Build & Bundle Tree-Shaking Gate: Run npm run build; verify clean compilation in < 4.0s with 0 unresolved imports, 0 warnings on missing exports, and measurable bundle asset reduction.
AC-5: 100% Full-Suite Regression Pass: Execute npm run test:product; verify 100% of all 651+ automated test assertions across all 4 stages pass with zero defects.

AC-6: Real-DOM 68-Route Playwright Browser Audit: Run automated Playwright crawl visiting all 68 canonical routes across Candidate, Recruiter, Enterprise, Admin, and Public surfaces, proving: (a) 0 HTTP errors, (b) 0 console/runtime errors, (c) 0 blank pages, and (d) all primary navigation landmarks intact.
AC-7: Quality Gates Pass: vite build < 4.0s, eslint 0 errors, npm test 0 regressions.

AC-8: Stale Docs, Orphaned Test Probes & Transient Artifact Hygiene: Audit and safely retire non-canonical one-off test probes (*probe*.js, *diag*.js, reproduce-*.mjs), stale documentation referencing deprecated architectures, and transient debug artifacts (crawl-artifacts/, obsolete screenshots), preserving 100% of canonical tests (test:product 651/651) and living architectural runbooks.
